title: Meta AI Chip Deals Reshape Costs As Shares Trade Below Targets
title_zh: 由于股价低于目标，Meta AI 芯片交易重塑了成本
summary: Meta Platforms (NasdaqGS:META) has agreed to multi-billion-dollar, multi-year deals to expand its AI infrastructure. The company signed a major supply partnership with AMD for AI chips. Meta also entered a large lease agreement for access to Google TPUs.
summary_zh: Meta Platforms（纳斯达克GS：META）已同意达成数十亿美元的多年期协议，以扩展其人工智能基础设施。该公司与 AMD 签署了人工智能芯片的主要供应合作伙伴关系。 Meta 还签订了一份大型租赁协议，以获取 Google TPU。

title: Amazon’s US$50b OpenAI Deal Recasts AWS And Valuation Story
title_zh: 亚马逊 50 亿美元的 OpenAI 交易重塑了 AWS 和估值故事
summary: Amazon.com (NasdaqGS:AMZN) announces a $50 billion investment and technology partnership with OpenAI. Amazon Web Services will become the exclusive cloud provider for OpenAI's enterprise platform.
summary_zh: Amazon.com（纳斯达克股票代码：AMZN）宣布与 OpenAI 建立 500 亿美元的投资和技术合作伙伴关系。亚马逊网络服务将成为 OpenAI 企业平台的独家云提供商。

title: TSMC’s US$2t Milestone And Apple Deal Reshape Chip Investment Case
title_zh: 台积电2吨里程碑与苹果交易重塑芯片投资案例
summary: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing (NYSE:TSM) has reached a market capitalization of about US$2t, placing it among the most highly valued companies globally.
summary_zh: 台积电 (NYSE:TSM) 的市值已达到约 2 吨美元，跻身全球估值最高的公司之列。

title: Formula One Group Extends Concorde Deal And Adds MotoGP For Growth
title_zh: 一级方程式集团延长协和飞机交易并增加 MotoGP 以促进增长
summary: Formula One Group (NasdaqGS:FWON.K) has agreed a new Concorde Agreement running through 2030. The company has expanded its media rights partnerships, including a new deal with Apple in the U.S.
summary_zh: 一级方程式集团 (NasdaqGS:FWON.K) 已同意签署一项新的协和协议，该协议将持续至 2030 年。该公司扩大了媒体版权合作伙伴关系，其中包括与美国苹果公司达成的新协议。

title: Is the Trump Bull Market on Its Last Leg? 4 Historically Accurate Indicators Offer a Clear Answer.
title_zh: 特朗普牛市已到最后阶段了吗？ 4 个历史准确的指标提供了明确的答案。
summary: When things seem too good to be true on Wall Street, they often are.
summary_zh: 当华尔街的事情看起来好得令人难以置信时，事实往往就是如此。
